title: Hoshino Ichika — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ichika's birthday
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's the earliest celebration of Ichi's birthday! And the second half is a sleepover☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! We're gonna have so much fun tonight♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm sure you know, but don't overdo it, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But still...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I felt this when we slept over in SEKAI that other time, but it's kind of exciting to be at school late at night.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I kinda know what you mean. It's not usually allowed, after all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It feels sort of special somehow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not only that, today's the day that we're gonna do all the things that you want to, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, keep them coming!
Don't hesitate to tell us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, then, here goes.
I want to...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Watch a Miku concert with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? One of my concerts? Together...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I brought over my favorite DVD, and I was hoping that we could all watch it together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, Ichika, we shouldn't have expected anything less from you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, let's get everything set up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ichika seems all wound up and ready to go.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, she does. She's holding the plushies Saki and I gave her and fidgeting in her seat.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why are you two staring at me like that? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Shiho
rows.Line:
Nothing's wrong.
Nothing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow, it's just the first song, but everybody's already so energized.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's the thing!
The band arrangement for this song is particularly striking.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku's outfit is really cool too, and her dancing is really sharp... Oh, like that part just now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. That was pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, I know this song.
It feels like it's meant to be performed live.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! The crowd's all singing along!
That looks like so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ichika...?
You seem anxious. Do you want to sing with her?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, umm... Yes.
I can sing as loudly as I want here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we all sing along?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...!
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, how about we join in during the next chorus? Ready? Here it comes!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it was.
I can see why you like this DVD so much, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! The set list had such a perfect flow to it that I started tearing up while watching!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So did a lot of people in the crowd. And so did Ichika, halfway through.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That last song always gets me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was also really moved.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This concert was really good, so I kinda want to see some other ones too. You still have more, right, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's see... This one's pretty old, but...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm starting to get sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me too...
I think we'll hit the hay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Okay, good night.
The girls are safe in our hands.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You and the others also seem very sleepy, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm having trouble keeping my eyes open...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too... Down I go...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Wait, Saki, you're really heavy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shiho's already half-asleep.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But watching those Miku concerts, singing and doing cheers together was really fun.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we call it a night and go to bed?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll wake you up later, so there's no need to worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...? Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have to thank everyone again later for throwing such a fun birthday party for me...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And staying up so late with me like this.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone, good night.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's nice to start off another year of life with a birthday like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hoshino.
I messaged you pretty late last night, so I was surprised when you replied right away.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I heard that you all had a sleepover and watched Miku concerts together. I have to think that watching them with you must've been really fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hoshino.
I wish I'd sent you a message too, since I was actually awake at the time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika!
I heard that you didn't get much sleep last night. Make sure to get plenty of rest tonight, okay? And don't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika!
I'm glad to hear that the sleepover you had last night ended up being really fun! I'd love to hear your recommendations for Miku concerts sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Miku plushie I picked is so wonderhoy! It's Miku in a hero-style outfit making a fashionably late entrance! She'll always be on your side no matter what happens, Ichika☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Ichika!
Wait, you look really sleepy. Your eyes are barely open...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii, her and the others apparently had a birthday sleepover last night. It sounded like they stayed up very late, so I think that explains that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well now, that sounds like a lot of fun. It really feels like youth too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, why don't we as MORE MORE JUMP! give her a boost of energy by celebrating?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's give it a go. We'll have to really put our hearts into it since she's on the other side of the screen. Ready? Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hoshino.
Did you and the others... Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika!!! Happy birthday!!! I, Tsukasa Tenma, shall take the lead in ensuring that this upcoming year goes splendidlyー Wait, Nene, don't run off with the camera! Come back here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Talk about being obnoxious... Anyway, happy birthday. I hope your music reaches the hearts of lots and lots of people, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yawn... Wow, that sleepover was so much fun!
I had a blast watching all those Miku concerts with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. I actually began tearing up a little since Miku was the one who brought us all back together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You, Saki and Ichika were all crying during that last concert. To be fair, it hit me pretty hard too, with everything to think about...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to keep striving towards producing music like that, the kind that really leaves an impression on people. Again, Ichika, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for all the birthday wishes, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Staying up late in SEKAI was so much fun. And spending time with all of my favorite people made it a wonderful memory.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can make a precious memory with Miku by watching one of her concerts by yourself, or make a special memory with someone else by watching it with them. Being able to connect with others through music is just so nice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We promise to keep doing our best so that we're able to produce that kind of music for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you all for always being so great.
And we look forward to your continued support.
